capabilities: Render the active note as live 1920×1080 slides in a side pane
Auto-layout slides from Markdown structure with overflow pagination and scaling
Export a deck as a self-contained HTML file with embedded fonts and images
Export the deck as a silent 1920×1080 H.264 MP4 video
Navigate slides by section and frame with keyboard, pointer, and a bottom bar
extras: Desktop-only. MP4 export requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later and a compatible H.264 encoder; the MP4 is silent and fixed at 1080p/30fps. Tier 3 background presets load from the author's Cloudflare R2 bucket but are off by default; remote images in notes are fetched and inlined only during HTML export. Manifest carries an unreviewed-by-Obsidian-staff notice.
intentEvidence: Powered by Marp, with a structure-aware layout engine that picks grids, balances columns, and guarantees overflow-free slides
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn ordinary notes into presentation-grade slides without hand-authoring slide syntax or manually fixing overflowing slides.

relations.evidence: Powered by Marp, with a structure-aware layout engine
no AI, cloud renderer, Remotion runtime, or separate FFmpeg installation
no AI, cloud renderer, Remotion runtime, or separate FFmpeg installation

summary: Slide renderer that turns Markdown notes into auto-laid-out 1920×1080 presentations, powered by Marp, with self-contained HTML and MP4 export.
